training_data: same 92 geometry-qualified BHSD official-train scans as v1; no test, Seg-CQ500 or MR-BHSD data used
sampling: each epoch: all hemorrhage-positive slices + equal number of random negative slices
augmentation: horizontal flip, random affine (rotation +-10 deg, scale 0.9-1.1), HU offset +-5, Gaussian noise sd 3 HU
inference: flip TTA; threshold 0.5; intracranial post-mask (dilated 2 px) from HU>300 bone shell; QC gate p01>-500 => abstain
checkpoint: fixed final epoch; no validation/test-based selection or threshold tuning
primary_comparison: paired per-scan Dice v2 vs v1 on all 96 BHSD test scans; secondary: volume ICC, Seg-CQ500 43, MR-BHSD 43
known_bias: design choices informed by v1 failure analysis (aggregate test results known); not untouched-holdout model selection
